title: Senior Developer, Infrastructure & Integrations

postalAddress.streetAddress: 1400-225 King Street West, Toronto ON M5C 3M2

descriptionHtml:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity's Technology Operations group builds and runs the platforms our internal teams rely on every day. We're looking for a Senior Developer, Infrastructure & Integrations, to own the infrastructure, governance, and lifecycle behind the tools our teams build in-house. Reporting to the Manager, Business Applications, you'll take end-to-end ownership of our internal application estate — development, hosting, access control, versioning, security, and ongoing maintenance — and set the standards that keep it secure and supportable as it grows.

 

What you'll do:

  • Build and run a dedicated AWS environment for internal, non-customer-facing applications using managed services including S3, CloudFront, API Gateway and IAM.

  • Own the deployment path — source control and versioning release, rollback and monitoring.

  • Define and manage role-based access tiers for hosted applications, and enforced consistently through Okta.

  • Build and maintain an inventory of internally built applications, including those developed outside a formal process, and assess each for data exposure and access risk.

  • Own vulnerability remediation across the internal application estate, — tracking, prioritization and closure against agreed timelines.

  • Develop and maintain internal applications where needed

  • Start from business outcomes, not solutions — own the technical design, challenge solution-first requests, and validate assumptions before building.

  • Set and own our integration standards — including our approach to MCP — defaulting to vendor-provided servers, using established open-source options where there's a real gap, and building custom only with a substantiated reason.

  • Build and maintain a reusable integration layer between internal applications and our systems of record (Jira, Zendesk, NetSuite,Salesforce, etc).

  • Assess inherited internal applications and decide, for each, whether to keep, migrate or retire it. For the ones we keep, take ownership — patching, credential rotation, cost and access reviews — and execute the retirements for the rest.

  • Partner with AI Enablement and our AI champions on tool hosting, and keep stakeholders and leadership informed on estate health — inventory, vulnerabilities, and migration progress.

  • Build working depth in our integration platform (Workato) and data platform (BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran, Tableau), acting as a second set of hands on systems that currently have a single owner.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of software development or cloud infrastructure experience, with hands-on production ownership of an AWS environment.

  • Practical depth in AWS managed services (S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, IAM), with a preference for low-operational-overhead solutions.

  • Experience implementing SSO and identity-based access control at the edge rather than in application code — ideally with Okta.

  • Strong development fundamentals: source control, environments, versioning, rollback, and documentation.

  • Experience with security and compliance in a SaaS environment — audit trails, sensitive-data handling, and closing out vulnerabilities on a schedule.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating enterprise SaaS systems through APIs, with enough familiarity with MCP to evaluate a vendor's implementation.

  • Sound judgment about what not to build — able to recommend a vendor or open-source option over custom development.

  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Workato, or governed low-code builders is a plus.

  • A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.
